gloss: juggling several jobs or roles at once

definitions.gloss: holding several jobs, roles, or commitments at the same time
definitions.explanation: Taking on two or more jobs, roles, or activities concurrently and dividing one's time among them. Often used of part-time jobs, club activities, or appointments.

examples.japanese: アルバイトを{掛|か}け{持|も}ちする。
examples.english: to work several part-time jobs at once.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つのクラブを{掛|か}け{持|も}ちしている。
examples.english: I belong to two clubs at the same time.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{仕事|しごと}と{家事|かじ}を{掛|か}け{持|も}ちして{毎日|まいにち}{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: She juggles work and housework, so she is busy every day.

notes:
Describes managing multiple commitments in parallel. Frequently used with アルバイト (part-time jobs) and クラブ (clubs). As a する-verb it means to carry on several things at once.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アルバイトの{掛|か}け{持|も}ち: working several part-time jobs
- {掛|か}け{持|も}ちで{働|はたら}く: to work multiple jobs
- スケジュールを{掛|か}け{持|も}ちする: to juggle overlapping schedules
